contexts.text: Like touching the pupil of the eye...
As a man guards the pupil of his eye.
The pupils of their eyes as it were flashed in a green plane.
Hence the iris and pupil appear now dilated, now contracted; now obscure, now lucid; and sometimes sparkling, exactly according to the desire and longing of the understanding.
The pupils of the eyes sparkled... then became opaque, and the irises became green...
